subject: Confidential: development intervention notes for Rohan Mehta (pre-PIP)
messages:
From: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 20 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Confidential: development intervention notes for Rohan Mehta (pre-PIP)

Priya / Vivek —

I'm opening a confidential thread to document a sustained performance concern with Rohan Mehta (eng-ml). I'm keeping this high level here and attaching a short running log. Key points:

- Pattern: missed milestones and slipping on integration tasks across Q1–Q2 2027 (three missed delivery dates, repeated late reviews).
- Examples: 2027-03-18: missed inference optimization milestone (no delivery, no heads-up); 2027-04-05: late CR with unresolved comments; 2027-05-02: missed on-call handover causing incident response delay.
- Impact: delays to the customer-facing perf rollout (affects two active Dedicated contracts), increased review load on IC peers, morale issues called out by teammates.

I've attached the running log with dates and supporting excerpts from PR threads. My read: coaching to clarify expectations + a short, measurable improvement window is appropriate before any formal PIP. Proposed plan (draft):

- 30-day focused coaching window starting next week (Mon 2027-05-24).
- Weekly 1:1s (agenda to cover deliverables, blockers, concrete examples).
- Clear success metrics: on-time delivery for scheduled tasks, CR turnaround <=48h for assigned reviewers, participation in on-call handovers with checklist completion.
- Manager deliverables: weekly written summary to HR, triage support to remove blockers, and pairing for two highest-priority tasks.

Questions for HR/Leadership:
- Is 30 days an acceptable improvement window here or should we extend to 45?
- Any mandatory HR wording/forms we need to include before I share this plan with Rohan?
- If we move to a formal PIP, are there standard templates/doc retention rules I should start applying now?

Attachments: [Attachment: coaching_log_20270520.csv (CSV, 14KB)]

Thanks — very confidential, please don't loop others yet.

— Tessa Morgan
Senior Manager, Platform ML
Redwood Inference

From: Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwood.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 20 May 2027 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Confidential: development intervention notes for Rohan Mehta (pre-PIP)

Tessa —

Thanks for the summary and the log. I reviewed the attachment and agree with documenting a focused improvement period before a formal PIP. A few points and HR requirements:

1) Window length: recommended 30–45 days depending on task cadence. Given the missed delivery pattern and the customer impact you noted, 30 days is defensible if we can be strict on measurement. If the work items are multi-week, consider 45 days.

2) Documentation: use our HR coaching template (attached) for the official record; it contains required language for expectations, improvement measures, and confidentiality. Please copy HR to each weekly summary email.

3) Communication: do not mention PIP in the initial coaching message to the employee. Frame it as a "developmental improvement plan" with explicit criteria. If we escalate to PIP, we'll follow the standard PIP checklist (link below) and sync with Legal for any contractual concerns.

4) Accommodations: check with Rohan on any external factors (family, health, workload) before assuming intent. Document any accommodations we agree to.

5) Suggested immediate actions: set a short prioritized backlog (2–3 deliverables) for the window; pick one performance metric tied to deliverables and one behavior metric (e.g., CR responsiveness).

I attached the template and added a draft agenda for the first 1:1. I'll open HR-412 (tracking ticket) and link it here once created. For legal questions I've CC'd employmentlaw@external-legal.com; they can advise if any contract-specific steps are required.

Attachments: [Attachment: hr_coaching_template.docx (DOCX, 28KB)]
Links: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1a2b3c_prepip_coaching_template

— Priya Natarajan
People Partner, Redwood Inference

From: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>
To: Rohan Mehta <rohan.mehta@redwood.com>

Date: Mon, 24 May 2027 08:45:00 -0700
Subject: Development plan and 30-day improvement window (confidential)

Rohan —

I wanted to have a clear conversation and follow up in writing about performance expectations for the next 30 days. Priya and Vivek are copied for support and documentation. This is a coaching conversation; the goal is to help you get fully back on track.

Why: Over the past quarter we've seen a few missed deliveries and delayed CRs that have impacted the team's roadmap and a live performance rollout. We want to make expectations very concrete so there's no ambiguity.

30-day plan (May 24 — Jun 23):
- Priority deliverables: Complete inference-optimizations PR #458 (owned by you) and close the integration blockers for Dedicated rollout by Jun 7.
- CR responsiveness: aim to address assigned review comments within 48 hours.
- On-call handover: use the on-call checklist and confirm handoff with next shift.
- Visibility: send a short weekly status email each Friday to me and Priya that includes completed items, blockers, and next steps.

Success criteria (concrete):
- PR #458 merged or placed on an approved alternate plan by Jun 7.
- Average CR turnaround for your assigned reviews <= 48h during the window.
- No missed on-call handovers; checklist completed for any shift transitions.

Support I'll provide: pairing sessions twice during the window, unblock escalation if an adjacent team has to deliver a dependency, and weekly 1:1s (we'll add a 30-minute slot).

If substantial improvement is not visible by the end of the 30 days, we will consider moving to a formal performance improvement plan (PIP). That is not the intent today — it's simply the next step if required.

Please reply acknowledging and add anything you think is unclear or unrealistic. We'll schedule our first weekly check-in for Tue May 25 at 10:00am.

— Tessa Morgan
Senior Manager, Platform ML

- PR #458: I'm on track to open the final update by Tue Jun 7 but would like 1 hour of pairing time the week of Jun 1 to review performance tests (would help avoid another late round).
- CR turnaround: I will set a status in the team channel to flag reviews I own to prompt quicker attention.
- On-call handover: noted; I'll adopt the checklist starting this week and confirm with the next shift.
- Context: I did have two overlapping high-priority incidents in April that compressed delivery; I'm happy to share more context in 1:1.

If we can get the pairing slot and ensure the two priority dependencies are assigned, I think the 30-day window is fair. I also want to make sure feedback is documented so we have a clear record.

Acknowledged — looking forward to the check-in on Tue.
